summary: This Phase 2 clinical trial looks at how the drug dapagliflozin affects blood sugar levels in people who have had weight-loss surgery, known as bariatric surgery. The study includes participants both with and without type 2 diabetes, which is a condition where the body has trouble managing blood sugar. The trial plans to enroll 30 participants. Dasman Diabetes Institute is sponsoring the study, and it is currently Enrolling by invitation.
